excerpt: sPHENIX is a radical makeover of the PHENIX experiment. The sPHENIX detector is about the size of a two-story house and weighs 1,000 tons. A 20-ton cylindrical solenoid originally from the BaBar experiment at SLAC ... the 20-ton solenoid was installed as part of the sPHENIX assembly project in 2021.
